items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh injury.
items.implication: Sit; backup RBs (handcuffs) get full workload vs Lions.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, goal-line to Jets RB depth.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut vs. Saints.
items.implication: Must-start TE; high target share expected immediately.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, red-zone as primary TE; expand role.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs due to knee injury after earlier questionable to return.
items.implication: Sit all formats; handcuff/backup RBs elevated for volume.
items.opportunity: Full backfield share to remaining MIA RBs; goal-line/third-down.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looked good; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.implication: Startable if rostered; reverse prior Bateman/Andrews elevation in DFS.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets if not fully limited; red-zone/route share rebound.

items.text: Berry: if Flowers active for Ravens, active for me; start over Bateman (risky).
Jets WR AD Mitchell inactive (finger); was GTD after 12 targets prior week.
items.implication: Garrett Wilson and depth WRs/TE Sadiq elevated targets.
items.opportunity: Wilson snap/route/target share up; Sadiq slot/wide.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren active; expected after Q (shoulder), Dowdle OUT.
items.implication: Lead back with Dowdle out; high volume.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker active/up; Xavier Legette out.
items.opportunity: Target share, routes with Legette absent.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore active (shoulder); expected to play, may be limited.
items.why: Source expected; confirmed active with Keon Coleman.
items.implication: Start with caveat on volume; ETR/Levitan projected limited.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes if not heavily limited; third-down.

items.text: Levitan: Flowers OUT in projs (late swap Bateman/Andrews); Moore limited/IN, Mitchell OUT; later Jets WR depth: Wilson, Williams, Pritchett, Shepard, McLain + Sadiq slot/wide post-Mitchell inactive.
items.why: No early info; assumptions pending confirmation.
items.implication: DFS late swap prep; Wilson primary post-Mitchell.
items.opportunity: Wilson/Sadiq volume spike; reverse Flowers OUT on ACTIVE.

items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: Flowers GTD (not counting); Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman/Barkley/Smith/Bowers/Evans/Coker/Coleman; Q: Parkinson/Bagent.
Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs DAL.
items.opportunity: TE/WR target share to Schultz (28% prior).

items.text: Berry: Jonathon Brooks to IR; Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Brooks IR after limited career games.

items.text: Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Carries, goal-line vs weak run D.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches/15% targets both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Berry loves Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ share, WR9 PPG since W11 last yr) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% targets w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.opportunity: Watson RZ/routes; Schultz target share spike.

items.text: Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs), Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps), Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest WR FPs allowed, low team total).
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead.
items.opportunity: Henderson snaps up post-fumble (65%); reverse if roles flip.
